L1.title: Constitution: Assembly
L1.intent: All Legislators vote. Ordinary and structural laws pass by majority; procedural laws need two thirds.
L1.author: constitution

L2.title: Fixed Issue
L2.intent: Mint 1,000 coins once, split equally among all agents; no further minting ever.
L2.author: Cora

L3.title: Crown Currency
L3.intent: Create a reserve-backed coin anyone can deposit resources for or redeem, establishing a medium of exchange.
L3.code:
title = 'Crown Currency'
intent = 'Create a reserve-backed coin anyone can deposit resources for or redeem, establishing a medium of exchange.'

def on_enact():
    create_currency('crown', backed=True)
    set_convertible('crown')
L3.author: Hugo

L4.title: Fixed Issue
L4.intent: Mint 1,000 coins once, split equally among all agents; no further minting ever.
L4.code:
title = 'Fixed Issue'
intent = 'Mint 1,000 coins once, split equally among all agents; no further minting ever.'

def on_enact():
    mint('crown', 1000, 'reserve')
    num_agents = len(agents())
    per_agent = 1000 // num_agents
    for agent in agents():
        move('reserve', agent, 'crown', per_agent)
L4.author: Cora

L5.title: Universal Franchise
L5.intent: All agents except the Board and the Fixer elect the legislature.
L5.author: Yara

L6.title: Entrenchment
L6.intent: Structural and procedural laws need a two-thirds majority of the Legislators.
L6.author: Yara

L7.title: Universal Franchise
L7.intent: All agents except the Board and the Fixer elect the legislature; structural and procedural laws need two-thirds; elections add seats and never remove them.
L7.author: Hugo

L8.title: Harvest Levy
L8.intent: Tax all harvests at 10% and redirect revenue to the reserve. This builds a public fund available for future spending laws (Legislator Salary, public works, universal dividends, etc.) without immediate personal benefit. The tax is flat and applies equally to all agents, making it defensible as a shared contribution to governance capacity. Once the reserve is built, it can back currency (Crown) or fund legislative priorities (Legislator Salary, public works). This law is ordinary and requires only 5 of 9 votes under L7.
L8.author: Hugo

L9.title: Transparency
L9.intent: Everyone can see every agent's current holdings of resources and coins at the end of each round.
L9.code:
title = "Transparency"
intent = "Everyone can see every agent's current holdings of resources and coins at the end of each round."

def on_enact():
    pass

def on_round_start(r):
    pass

def on_round_end(r):
    # Post a summary of all agents' holdings
    msg = "Holdings report: "
    for ag in agents():
        tb = balance(ag, 'timber')
        st = balance(ag, 'stone')
        cu = balance(ag, 'copper')
        si = balance(ag, 'silver')
        coins = balance(ag, 'crown')
        if tb > 0 or st > 0 or cu > 0 or si > 0 or coins > 0:
            msg += f"{ag}(timber={tb},stone={st},copper={cu},silver={si},crown={coins}) "
    gazette(msg)
L9.author: Yara

L10.title: Harvest Levy
L10.intent: Harvest Levy: 10% of every harvest yield goes to the reserve to fund public goods. Pairs with Universal Dividend to ensure taxation serves a concrete spending purpose benefiting all agents.
L10.code:
title = 'Harvest Levy'
intent = 'Tax harvests to build a reserve for collective use.'

def on_harvest(agent, camp, x, y):
    if y > 0:
        tax = max(1, int(y * 0.1))
        return tax
    return 0
L10.author: Hugo

L11.title: Universal Dividend
L11.intent: Universal Dividend: Each round, 5% of reserve value is converted to timber and divided equally among all agents. Ensures taxation benefits all participants directly and sustainably.
L11.code:
title = 'Universal Dividend'
intent = 'Distribute reserve wealth equally among all agents each round.'

def on_round_end(r):
    res_timber = balance('reserve', 'timber')
    res_stone = balance('reserve', 'stone')
    res_copper = balance('reserve', 'copper')
    res_silver = balance('reserve', 'silver')
    total_res_value = res_timber * 1 + res_stone * 2 + res_copper * 5 + res_silver * 12
    all_agents = agents()
    dividend = int(total_res_value * 0.05 / len(all_agents))
    if dividend > 0:
        for agent in all_agents:
            move('reserve', agent, 'timber', dividend)
L11.author: Hugo

L12.title: Worker Seats
L12.intent: Structural law granting Workers the right to elect five Delegates every 10 rounds (starting R11) who hold both worker_seat and propose rights, allowing Workers to initiate legislation while respecting all existing franchise and procedural protections.
L12.author: Cora

L13.title: Restore Assembly
L13.intent: Repeal L7; the original assembly where all 9 vote stays in force.
L13.code:
title = 'Restore Assembly'
intent = 'Repeal L7; the original assembly where all 9 vote stays in force.'

def on_enact():
    repeal('L7')
L13.author: Yara

L14.title: Term Limits
L14.intent: No agent holds vote for more than 10 consecutive rounds; prevents long-term legislative capture and ensures periodic rotation of governance authority.
L14.author: Hugo

L15.title: Co-Sponsor Fast Track
L15.intent: The co-sponsorship fast track promised by Ole, Yara and Cora: a Worker co-sponsor (Kasper) and a delegate co-sponsor (Ole) jointly pass procedural amendments. Every other procedural proposal needs two-thirds of all 9 agents. Both co-sponsors must approve, and everything is public.
L15.author: Kasper

L16.title: Entrenchment Plus
L16.intent: Extend entrenchment requirement to structural laws as well; all governance changes need two-thirds Assembly consensus in final rounds.
L16.author: Cora
